title: 6th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/6/3/2025).

Question by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to Minister of Economic Development and Trade Mohamed Saeed: under former President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, UK duty on Maldivian fish exports was cut from 24% to 20% and a free trade agreement to remove it entirely was set to take effect in 2025; what stage is that agreement at, and why was it not raised at the Maldives-UK Dialogue meeting on 28 May 2025?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request, under Articles 115(f)(2) and 93(a) of the Constitution, for Parliament's consent for the Maldives to accede to and ratify the United Nations Convention against Cybercrime is sent to the relevant standing committee.
Preliminary debate on the Human Organ Transplantation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Feydhoo South MP Ibrahim Didi.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on the Auditor General's Office budget for 2026.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the trade minister on the UK fish-duty deal, sent the UN cybercrime convention to committee, opened debate on the organ transplant bill, and took the committee report on the Auditor General's 2026 budget.
